uiGate.finding: Run Screening requires readiness counts with readyForQualification > 0, notReady=0, methodGap=0, plus current assumption acceptance.

requestBuilder.finding: Workspace request construction requires AivReadinessTableEnvelope.v2 and fails if readiness has NOT_READY or METHOD_GAP blockers.

registeredAdapter.finding: validateInput checks only non-empty tables/topology and assumption-profile validity; it does not invoke AIV readiness or verify readiness-equivalent engineering domains.

currentCalculator.finding: screening mode validates profile/table existence then executes source/relationship calculations without buildAivReadiness or an executable-contract assertion.

registeredEngine.finding: calculateEngineering resolves inputs, runs adapter custom validation, then calls the adapter calculate implementation. The shared engine has an existing hook sufficient for AIV-specific fail-closed validation; no shared-engine change is currently justified.
